baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 supplies enduring residence; words 3 and 5 frame it as a divine commitment matching reality; words 7 and 8 name capacity and exact governance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Persistence, pledged speech, reality-matching truth, unconquered capacity, and finished ordering form a mutually reinforcing guarantee: the state does not merely last accidentally but is made and kept non-failing.

activation_trace.role: Persistence resistant to quick decay supplies the duration that the guarantee must preserve.
A spoken commitment opening expectation supplies the future-directed pledge.
Stable correspondence with reality makes the pledge more than consoling speech.
Overcoming resistance supplies the capacity by which no obstruction defeats fulfillment.
Tight finishing and reliable construction make the enduring state deliberately ordered.

changed_reading.before: A promise that the residents will remain for a very long time.
changed_reading.after: A non-failing state whose duration, factuality, power, and deliberate construction guarantee one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 participle and its locative complement can carry settled attachment as well as elapsed duration, while words 3 and 5 give that attachment a committed basis.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adhesion branch of خ ل د turns abiding from an infinite clock into non-detachment from the promised state. The pledge opens the relation and the obligatory branch of truth makes it hold rather than dissolve.

activation_trace.role: Settling, clinging, and staying with something supply a relational mode of permanence.
The one-sided pledge supplies the commitment to which the residents remain attached.
A fixed due or binding necessity supplies non-cancellation to the promised relation.

changed_reading.before: Abiding is only endless elapsed time inside a place.
changed_reading.after: Abiding is also durable belonging: the residents are not detached from the state secured by the pledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal promise at word 3, the emphatic truth at word 5, the locative complement, and the final wisdom epithet permit an appointed-and-fitted realization model.
baseline_models.mechanism: A promise can carry an appointed time or place; truth can image a part meeting its proper joint or receptacle; solidity and exact construction make the destination fit its recipients. The result is fulfillment as right placement, not only prediction coming true.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by an appointment supplies a concrete horizon and locus of realization.
A part meeting its proper joint or vessel supplies the image of fulfillment fitting its place.
Material firmness supplies resistance to deformation in the fitted destination.
Exact finishing supplies the ordering that makes the appointment and destination cohere.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces a generic future reward.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents an appointed realization in which recipients, destination, and durable order meet with exact fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding gardens resolve the otherwise unexpressed locative referent. Their branch images add enclosure by growth and a dwelling congenial to its occupant, so permanence becomes protected and qualitatively fitting habitation.

activation_trace.role: A garden enclosed and screened by growth supplies the concrete place picked up by the locative pronoun.
A place agreeable to its occupant supplies the qualitative fitness of the enduring residence.
Persistence without quick decay converts the identified garden setting into lasting habitation.

structural_cues: 31:8 immediately precedes 31:9 and supplies the nearest feminine plural/nonhuman antecedent for the singular feminine locative pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent gardens and bliss; I resolve the pronoun to those gardens and transfer their enclosure and suitability into the abiding model. A live alternative is that the pronoun points more broadly to the entire bliss state.

changed_reading.before: The residents remain in an unresolved or generic destination.
changed_reading.after: They remain in garden enclosures whose protection and suitability make eternity a mode of dwelling, not just a quantity of time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created order is presented through support, anchoring, and prevented sway. These material relations reactivate truth and wisdom in the focus as load-bearing integrity: the promise is stable because its maker can hold an ordered world against its failure mode.

activation_trace.role: A prop bearing another thing supplies the load-bearing comparison, while the local syntax denies visible props.
Fixing something so it settles supplies the stabilizing action assigned to the mountains.
Oscillation and lateral instability supply the failure mode that the created order prevents.
Tightly woven or well-formed integrity recasts truth as structural coherence.
Exact construction links the anti-sway world image back to the closing wisdom epithet.

structural_cues: 31:10 juxtaposes unseen supports, cast anchors, and an explicit prevention clause before describing distributed life and growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, fixation, and prevented motion; I treat world-stabilization as evidence for promise-stabilization. The alternative is that the creation scene demonstrates power generally without specifying how the promise is secured.

changed_reading.before: Truth means that the sentence is factually correct.
changed_reading.after: Truth also behaves as anti-sway architecture: the promised order is load-bearing, fixed, and protected against destabilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: A weighed mustard-grain hidden in rock or the widest domains is still brought forth. Smallness, concealment, and interior knowledge turn wise fulfillment into lossless retrieval: no item is beneath the resolution of the promise.

activation_trace.role: A calibrated weight supplies exact rather than approximate accounting.
The minute seed supplies the lower bound of what remains retrievable.
Massive hardness supplies an obstructing enclosure that does not defeat retrieval.
Fineness, minuteness, and hiddenness supply resolution at the scale of the concealed item.
Knowledge reaching an affair's interior supplies detection behind the enclosure.
Knowledge that reaches the right result links exact retrieval to wise fulfillment.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the object through grain, rock, heavens, and earth, then reverses concealment with a bringing verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact weight, extreme smallness, hard concealment, subtle access, and interior knowledge; I infer a lossless fulfillment mechanism. The scene can alternatively concern moral surveillance without describing the promise's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The promise is reliable in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: The promise is exact at grain-scale: hidden particulars are neither lost in the system nor averaged out of fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-surrender is directional, then becomes gripping something maximally reliable, and finally reaches the outcome of affairs. This sequence activates the adhesion branch of abiding: permanence is secure continuity maintained by orientation and hold, not inert occupancy.

activation_trace.role: Safety from defect supplies the condition produced by yielding the self toward God.
Direction and orientation make the surrender a trajectory rather than a static label.
Holding and retaining supply the active continuity of attachment.
Tight reliability supplies resistance to the held connection breaking.
The terminal outcome supplies the destination toward which the oriented hold persists.
Settled attachment converts the context's grip into a focus-anchored mode of abiding.

structural_cues: The uncatalogued ع ر و occurrence at 31:22 word 10 sits syntactically between holding and superlative reliability; it is used only as the structural handle, with no invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies orientation, holding, reliability, and final outcome; I read them as a path into durable belonging. The alternative is that the handhold only marks present faith and does not describe the later mode of residence.

changed_reading.before: Eternal residence begins only after arrival and is passively possessed.
changed_reading.after: Abiding can be read as held continuity: an oriented relation is retained through to its secure outcome and then does not detach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence explicitly grants enjoyment, quantifies it as little, then reverses agency through compulsion toward thick punishment. Against that bounded interval, word 1 in the focus marks not merely a longer reward but an opposing temporal regime with no forced exit.

activation_trace.role: A period kept in extension for enjoyment supplies the temporary interval being contrasted.
Small quantity explicitly bounds that interval.
Necessity and compulsion supply the involuntary transition that terminates enjoyment.
Thickness after thinness materializes the severity reached after the short interval.
Persistence resistant to ending supplies the opposite duration and absence of forced exit.

structural_cues: 31:24 orders enjoyment, explicit smallness, then compelled movement; 31:9 has residence without a terminating transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded pleasure interval and forced reversal; I use it as a temporal foil for focus abiding. The alternative is that the contrast distinguishes two populations without defining different kinds of time.

changed_reading.before: Reward lasts much longer than worldly enjoyment.
changed_reading.after: The focus contrasts temporal regimes: bounded enjoyment is terminated by coercion, while promised abiding has neither measured smallness nor forced displacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seas become replenishing ink yet divine words do not reach exhaustion, and the scene closes with the same two epithets as the focus. The focus promise is thereby heard as one divine word backed by a speech-source no material extension can drain.

activation_trace.role: Vast accumulated water supplies the apparently maximal writing resource.
Ink feeding a pen supplies the material conversion from seas into writable extension.
Exhaustion and cessation supply the negated failure mode of divine words.
An intelligible utterance supplies the class into which the focus pledge can be placed.
Unassailable strength repeats the focus seal and connects inexhaustible speech to capacity.
Exact ordering repeats the focus seal and connects inexhaustible speech to controlled fulfillment.
The spoken commitment anchors the inexhaustible-word model directly in the focus.

structural_cues: 31:27 ends with the exact focus epithet pair after negating exhaustion of divine words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inexhaustible words and the repeated epithet pair; I classify the focus promise as a divine word and let non-exhaustion characterize its backing. The alternative is that the shared formula describes the speaker without transferring the sea-and-ink image to this particular promise.

changed_reading.before: The promise is one finite utterance whose reliability depends only on speaker credibility.
changed_reading.after: The promise participates in an inexhaustible word-source: neither expression nor capacity is depleted before fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creating and raising the whole population is equated with handling one self. The mighty-wise guarantee therefore has no batch-size degradation: multitude does not dilute attention, capacity, or ordered realization.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies the first large-scale operation.
Stirring what is still from rest supplies the restoration operation relevant to fulfillment.
A self as an individuated entity supplies the unit against which the multitude is measured.
Numerical oneness supplies the explicit scale equivalence.
Unopposed capacity turns scale equivalence into assurance that no population overwhelms fulfillment.
Controlled construction keeps the many-to-one equivalence ordered rather than indiscriminate.

structural_cues: 31:28 uses an exclusive comparison to collapse collective creation and raising to the scale of one self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies many-to-one operational equivalence; I apply it to the capacity behind the focus promise. The alternative is that the comparison addresses resurrection feasibility only, not the individualized quality of the promised state.

changed_reading.before: Divine power is sufficient to fulfill the promise for everyone.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment is scale-invariant: adding recipients neither strains capacity nor reduces the precision owed to each one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Day and night enter one another while celestial bodies flow to a fixed endpoint. That regime of cycling motion and appointed cessation throws focus abiding into relief as a different temporality: settled persistence beyond the clocks that measure the present order.

activation_trace.role: One interval entering inside another supplies recurrent temporal interpenetration.
Continuous flowing supplies motion through the governed cycle.
A prescribed endpoint supplies the limit at which cosmic running stops.
Persistence resistant to ending supplies the contrast with endpoint-bound motion.
The packet's split mapped target contributes annual cycling, sharpening the exploratory contrast between counted recurrence and fulfillment.

structural_cues: 31:29 repeats reciprocal entry of night and day, then gives both celestial runners one appointed temporal boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cycles, running, and an endpoint; I contrast that measured regime with focus persistence and use the split promise mapping as a secondary annual-cycle cue. The alternative is that abiding remains ordinary endless time rather than a distinct temporal regime.

changed_reading.before: Eternity is the current sequence of days extended without limit.
changed_reading.after: Eternity may be persistence beyond the interlocking, running, endpoint-bound clocks of the created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later declaration identifies God with stable reality and places invoked alternatives in the category that departs from truth and constancy. The focus promise is therefore true not only by accurate prediction but derivatively: it issues from the source aligned with reality rather than the vanishing rival order.

activation_trace.role: Stable reality opposed to falsehood supplies an ontological predicate for the divine guarantor.
Departure from truth and stability supplies the vanishing counter-order against which the promise stands.
The pledge anchors the ontological contrast to the specific speech-act in the focus.
Reality-matching truth transfers the guarantor's ontological status to the focus assertion without making them identical.

structural_cues: 31:30 uses parallel identification clauses for God, invoked alternatives, and divine elevation; the truth/falsehood opposition is explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the guarantor-as-truth and rival-as-falsehood contrast; I infer that the promise's truth derives from its source. The alternative is to keep 31:30's predicate ontological and 31:9's adverbial truth merely propositional.

changed_reading.before: The promise is true because a trustworthy speaker predicts accurately.
changed_reading.after: The promise is reality-aligned because it proceeds from the True; its alternatives lack the stability needed to become enduring reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact promise-and-truth formula returns inside a warning where no parent or child can discharge another's account and deceptive appearances must not induce delay. The focus assurance remains good news, but its guarantee now has a second edge: promised order includes non-transferable accountability.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in for another supplies the substitution that the local negation disallows.
Parent-child descent supplies the strongest human bond tested and denied as a substitute payer.
The repeated pledge carries the focus guarantee into the warning scene.
The repeated reality-matching assertion prevents the warning from being treated as rhetoric.
A bright but non-enduring lure supplies the perceptual mechanism that obscures the guarantee.
The same focus pledge anchors the warning's formula back to the promised abiding.

structural_cues: 31:33 repeats the word sequence promise, God, truth from 31:9 after two parallel denials of familial substitution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact formula repetition, blocked substitution, and anti-deception warnings; I read one guarantee as governing both reward and accountability. The alternative is that the repeated formula refers only to judgment while 31:9 remains independently consolatory.

changed_reading.before: The focus formula is exclusively reassurance for those receiving gardens.
changed_reading.after: The formula is a dual-edge guarantee: enduring reward is real, and the accountable order delivering it cannot be evaded by kinship or glittering delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge is located with God while each self lacks knowledge of tomorrow's acquisition and its land of death. An appointed promise can therefore be fully true without making its schedule inspectable to recipients; certainty belongs to the guarantor, not to human timetable access.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence locate decisive knowledge with the guarantor.
Practical knowing supplies the human access explicitly denied across two future questions.
The next day supplies the nearest future horizon that still remains unavailable.
Loss of life supplies the terminal event whose location is likewise concealed.
An appointed time or place supplies the schedule that may be fixed without being disclosed.
Reality-matching stability separates certainty of realization from access to its timing.

structural_cues: 31:34 places the Hour at word 5, but the supplied س و ع inventory has no usable time branch, so the occurrence is retained only as structural sequence evidence.
The ayah alternates divine knowledge statements with repeated denials of what a self knows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledge located with God and human ignorance of immediate and terminal futures; I separate guarantee from disclosure. The alternative is that the verse limits only contingent details and says nothing about whether the promise's broad timing is knowable.

changed_reading.before: A true appointed promise should provide recipients with a knowable schedule.
changed_reading.after: The appointment can be exact and certain while its timetable remains sealed; hidden timing does not weaken truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts promise from future speech toward a present omen and shifts abiding toward settled inward attention. It remains anchored in supplied focus branches for words 1, 3, and 5; render it only as an exploratory cognitive layer, not as replacement lexical senses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise noun, emphatic truth, and abiding participle jointly permit a present-sign reading alongside the ordinary future pledge.

activation_trace.role: A visible indication that raises expectation supplies the promise as present evidence of what is coming.
Making truth evident supplies verification of the anticipatory sign.
A thought settled in the heart supplies the inward persistence produced by that verified expectation.

changed_reading.before: The promise has no effect until its future fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: The promise can already operate as a verified omen that settles the coming permanence in the heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses a non-dominant mapped inventory under the focus promise root and imports a material water image. It remains inspectable through the packet's explicit split mapping and the focus persistence/joint branches; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for non-depletion, never a direct gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapped inventory for word 3 can interact with the persistence of word 1 and the fitted receptacle image of word 5.

activation_trace.role: A gathered water source that does not run dry supplies an exploratory reservoir model for the pledge.
Persistence against decay converts the reservoir image into uninterrupted provision.
A fitting vessel or joint supplies containment without leakage or mismatch.

changed_reading.before: The pledge is a statement that points to a later state.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the pledge is a perennial source whose promised state is continuously supplied rather than merely announced once.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The storm scene is remote from the garden antecedent and does not grammatically equate its canopy with the focus locative, so the comparison is surprising. It remains valid as a focus-anchored spatial counterimage: both ask what it means to be held within or under something, while rescue separates one enclosure from another. Render only as an inverse spatial analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 attachment branch and its locative complement can be tested against the later sequence of engulfment, rescue, and arrival on dry ground.

activation_trace.role: An upper cover that hides what is beneath supplies the engulfing mode of enclosure.
Interlocking turbulence makes that enclosure unstable and threatening.
An overhead canopy gives the wave a bounded spatial form comparable, cautiously, to being within a place.
Rescue by separation supplies the exit from the threatening enclosure.
Dry open land supplies the stable arrival surface after separation.
Settled attachment anchors the comparison in the focus and distinguishes secure belonging from engulfment.

changed_reading.before: Being inside or under a lasting enclosure is intrinsically secure.
changed_reading.after: The context forces a distinction between engulfing containment and stable belonging: focus abiding is permanence in the right enclosure, not mere inability to exit.

strongest_changes: The adjacent gardens resolve the locative and make abiding protected, fitting habitation rather than abstract duration.
Cosmic stabilization and grain-scale retrieval make truth both load-bearing and losslessly precise.
Inexhaustible divine words plus the repeated mighty-wise seal recast the promise as backed by a non-depleting source.
The truth/falsehood declaration and exact promise-formula recurrence make the guarantee ontological and dual-edged: reward is durable and accountability non-transferable.
The final knowledge sequence separates certainty from timetable disclosure, allowing an exact appointment to remain hidden.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several non-collapsible mechanisms at once: durable construction, attached belonging, appointed fit, exact retrieval, scale invariance, inexhaustible speech, temporal contrast, and ontological truth. Split mapped branches also yielded contained omen, annual-cycle, and perennial-source activations without displacing the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The nearest antecedent strongly favors the gardens, but the locative may encompass the wider bliss state.
Anti-sway, handhold, reservoir, and storm-enclosure mechanisms depend on explicit reader-supplied cross-domain arrows.
The non-dominant mappings under و ع د are packet-licensed but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The repeated 31:33 formula may govern judgment specifically rather than making every feature of the 31:9 assurance dual-edged.
